claimed: Hunt brief: 'Vyndaqel/Vyndamax IRA selection and price'.
page_said: Tafamidis is not in the CMS selected-drug and MFP file (data/external/ira_selected_drugs_mfp.zip, 2026-09-21 version: no TAFAMIDIS or VYNDA rows). Pfizer's 10-Q 2026Q2 p.35 lists only Eliquis (2026), Ibrance and Xtandi (2027) and Xeljanz (selected, but no MFP because CMS found a generic on the market).
action: No IRA nugget for Vyndaqel. Ibrance MFP used in PFE-nugget-007 instead.

claimed: Hunt brief: Pfizer's MFN rate is 0.65%, borrowed by the quant model for every company.
page_said: No 0.65% or any other MFN rate appears in any PFE document (grep of 10-Ks, 10-Qs, 8-Ks, releases, slides, policy press releases, 4 official transcripts). The Sep 30, 2025 release says specific terms remain confidential; Bourla refused to quantify on the 2025Q3 call (p.16) and deflected on the 2026Q2 call (p.15). The only '65%' hits are the Metsera $20.65 CVR and '12 products ... 65% of Total revenues'.
action: Logged as PFE-nugget-006 (absence verified). The source of the 0.65% is not in the corpus; flag to Aidan.

page_said: That is a tablet formulation patent (11065250*PED). The compound patent RE47739 expires Mar 5, 2027, with pediatric exclusivity to Sep 5, 2027 (drugs/ibrance/orange_book_patents.csv); the 10-K FY2025 patent table (p.7) gives US basic patent 2027.
action: Use Sep 5, 2027 in PFE-nugget-007. Do not put the code date on a slide.

page_said: 2035 is Pfizer's crystalline-form patent. The basic patent runs on an interim PTE to December 2026 with a PTE to 2028 pending (10-K FY2025 p.8), and settled generics may launch June 1, 2031, 'subject to the outcome of other litigation' (10-Q 2026Q2 p.29).
action: Use the 10-K and 10-Q dates in PFE-nugget-009.

claimed: out/PFE/labels_table.json: 'Approved indications (count)' = 2 for Ibrance, Verzenio and Kisqali.
page_said: The count hides the key difference: Verzenio and Kisqali labels carry section 1.1 Early Breast Cancer (adjuvant); Ibrance's section 1 covers advanced or metastatic disease only.
action: Label difference stated in PFE-nugget-007 peer column.
